versions.content: If an AtomicSwComponentType using a PortPrototype with an NvDataInterface invokes the explicit API Rte_Write and the attribute NvBlockDescriptor . supportDirtyFlag is set to true and the writing strategy storeAtShutDown ([SWS_Rte_04566] applies) is enabled, the RTE shall mark the as- sociated RAM Block (s) as CHANGED by calling the NvM_SetRamBlockStatus func- tion of the NvM module with the BlockChanged parameter set to true . The NvM_- SetRamBlockStatus function shall be called by the RTE after the data accessed by the Rte_Write function is written back to the RAM Block (s).
